title: IRDAI Issues Master Circular on Insurer Registration, Share Transfers and Amalgamation, Cuts Approval Fee by 80%
court: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
case_name: IRDAI Master Circular on Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers
citation: IRDAI master circular dated 2 November 2026, issued under the IRDAI (Registration of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 as amended in 2026
card_summary: IRDAI's 2 November 2026 master circular consolidates the formats and requirements for registering an insurer, changing its capital structure, transferring shares, and amalgamation, aligning them with the Registration Regulations, 2024 as amended this year. The regulator also cut the fee for approving a share transfer by 80%, to Rs 10 lakh. Press reports note fresh IPO-related requirements issued alongside it.
card_tip: A foreign joint-venture partner or promoter transferring shares in an Indian insurer should use IRDAI's new consolidated formats, not the pre-November 2026 forms, and can expect a sharply lower approval fee.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: foreign company (foreign joint-venture partners and promoters in Indian insurers, who need IRDAI approval for share transfers and capital changes). TARGET QUERY: IRDAI rules for insurer share transfer and amalgamation approval 2026. DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen (no search-volume or trending data was opened for this item). Cross-verified across Vinod Kothari & Co's summary, Angel One and CA Alley, which agree the master circular is dated 2 November 2026, covers registration, capital structure, share transfer and amalgamation of insurers under the Registration Regulations, 2024 as amended, prescribes application formats, and cuts the share-transfer approval fee by 80% to Rs 10 lakh. Sources differ on the exact circular reference number quoted (one gives IRDAI/F&I/CIR/MISC/142/11/2026); that reference is given as reported and should be checked against IRDAI's own site. The prior fee amount is not stated here as it was not independently confirmed from a source actually opened in this run.
